_comment: SSRF allowlist for outbound HTTP to integration services (spec §25.3). Exact host:port matches only; http/https only. Production copy lives in /etc/clovirassist/. S11 removed the n8n (5678) and runner (8787/8788/8789) hosts along with those services; S14 removed api.notion.com along with the Notion runtime (D-284). The migration CLI still reaches Notion, but through its own list (allowed-migration-sources.json) - the runtime must not be able to write back into the system of record. D-516 added api.openai.com (Responses and models) and auth.openai.com (Sign in with ChatGPT: token, revocation, JWKS) so an installer never has to edit this file by hand for the AI providers.
